notes: Summary: enterprise legal discovery vendor evaluating Redwood for embeddings + 2-stage rerank (ANN recall -> cross-encoder reranker). Heavy emphasis on auditability, retention, and private deployment.
Scale: currently ~12M parsed docs (contracts, briefs, correspondence) + expected ingest of 30M historical records over 6 months. Target index size ~40-60M passages.

Performance targets: P99 query latency with reranker <= 350ms, average latency (user-facing) ~120-200ms. Throughput target 200 qps for peak support searches; nightly batch reranking runs for reindexing.

Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.015/query (embedding recall + rerank amortized). Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization) to reduce token spend on reranker cross-encoder steps.

Model preferences: open to community LLMs for embedding (SBERT-family or fine-tuned LegalBERT embeddings) and a smaller cross-encoder tuned for legal text (T5-large / legal-distilBERT candidate). Wants ability to pin reranker variant per route.

Security / compliance: must run in customer VPC or on-prem appliance. KMS-backed key management with HSM option. SOC2 + ISO27001 compliance required. Audit logs must be immutable, searchable, retained for 7 years and exportable for e-discovery audits.

Routing / fallback: need policy to route EU-resident requester queries to EU-hosted nodes. Automatic fallback to lower-cost reranker when dedicated capacity saturated. Must support sticky routing by tenant and model pinning.
Customer quote (AE notes): 'We can't accept a black-box SaaS audit trail — legal ops needs full chain-of-custody for retrievals.'

POC ask: Redwood to ingest 10M-document snapshot (sanitized), run embedding + ANN indexing, validate recall@100 and reranker MRR uplift, measure end-to-end latency at 99th percentile, and demonstrate audit export for 90 days.
Integration requests: SCIM + SSO (SAML) for user provisioning, SFTP/secure-agent for bulk ingest, Delta sync API for incremental updates, and retention policy enforcement per-tenant.

Migration notes: existing infra uses Elastic for primary search + a home-grown cross-encoder; key ask is cost-per-query reduction without losing recall. Team prefers rollout path: POC -> pilot (3 teams) -> enterprise deployment w/ reserved capacity.
Internal stakeholders: Head of Legal Ops (Emily Torres), CTO (Rajiv Menon), Director of Infrastructure (Markus Feld). Primary buyer: Legal Ops / Head of E-discovery.
Decision timeline: Legal Ops decision by 2026-05, procurement sign-off by end of Q2 2026 assuming POC success.
Misc: Provided Redwood security FAQ; customer asked for sample audit log schema and latency SLO contract language. AE: Maya Chen; SE follow-up scheduled 2026-03-12 (perf test scoping).
